        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # WEEK 11: CUSTOMER SEGMENTATION & PREDICTION PROJECT\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        "\n",
        " import pandas as pd\n",
        " import numpy as np\n",
        " import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        " from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        " from sklearn.cluster import KMeans, AgglomerativeClustering, DBSCAN\n",
        " from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV\n",
        " from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        " from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 1: LOAD DATA\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " df = pd.read_csv(\"customer_churn (5).csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        " # Convert 'TotalCharges' to numeric, coercing errors and filling NaNs\n",
        " df['TotalCharges'] = pd.to_numeric(df['TotalCharges'], errors='coerce')\n",
        " # Fill NaNs in 'TotalCharges' (e.g., for new customers with no charges yet) with the mean\n",
        " df['TotalCharges'].fillna(df['TotalCharges'].mean(), inplace=True)\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"Dataset Shape:\", df.shape)\n",
        " print(\"\\nColumns:\", df.columns.tolist())\n",
        " print(\"\\nSample Data:\")\n",
        " print(df.head())\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 2: FEATURE SELECTION\n",
        " # Last column target maan rahe hain\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # Exclude 'CustomerID' from feature selection as it's an identifier\n",
        " feature_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['CustomerID', df.columns[-1]]]\n",
        " target_col = df.columns[-1]\n",
        "\n",
        " X = df[feature_cols]\n",
        " y = df[target_col]\n",
        "\n",
        " # Convert categorical features to numerical using one-hot encoding\n",
        " X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=True)\n",
        "\n",
        " # Scale features for clustering\n",
        " scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        " X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 3: ELBOW METHOD FOR KMEANS\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " inertia = []\n",
        "\n",
        " for i in range(1, 10):\n",
        "    km = KMeans(n_clusters=i, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "    km.fit(X_scaled)\n",
        "    inertia.append(km.inertia_)\n",
        "\n",
        " plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
        " plt.plot(range(1,10), inertia, marker='o')\n",
        " plt.xlabel(\"Clusters\")\n",
        " plt.ylabel(\"Inertia\")\n",
        " plt.title(\"Elbow Method\")\n",
        " plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 4: APPLY CLUSTERING ALGORITHMS\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        "\n",
        " # KMeans\n",
        " kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        " df['Segment'] = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        " # Hierarchical\n",
        " agg = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=3)\n",
        " df['Hierarchical_Segment'] = agg.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        " # DBSCAN\n",
        " dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=0.8, min_samples=5)\n",
        " df['DBSCAN_Segment'] = dbscan.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"\\nKMeans Segment Counts:\")\n",
        " print(df['Segment'].value_counts())\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 5: SEGMENT PROFILES\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # Create a DataFrame for profiling by combining the 'Segment' column from df\n",
        " # with the one-hot encoded features from the 'X' DataFrame.\n",
        " # This ensures that all features used for calculating the mean are numerical.\n",
        " df_for_profiling = X.copy()\n",
        " df_for_profiling['Segment'] = df['Segment'] # Add the segment labels to the feature set\n",
        "\n",
        " # Calculate the mean of each feature for each segment.\n",
        " segment_profiles = df_for_profiling.groupby('Segment').mean(numeric_only=True)\n",
        " print(\"\\nSegment Profiles:\")\n",
        " print(segment_profiles)\n",
        "\n",
        " segment_profiles.to_csv(\"segment_profiles.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 6: SEGMENT-WISE RANDOM FOREST MODELS\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " results = []\n",
        "\n",
        " for seg in sorted(df['Segment'].unique()):\n",
        "    seg_df = df[df['Segment'] == seg]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # small segment skip\n",
        "    if len(seg_df) < 20:\n",
        "        continue\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Re-create X_seg and y_seg from the original df and apply one-hot encoding to X_seg\n",
        "    X_seg_original = seg_df[feature_cols]\n",
        "    X_seg = pd.get_dummies(X_seg_original, drop_first=True) # Apply one-hot encoding here as well\n",
        "    y_seg = seg_df[target_col]\n",
        "\n",
        "    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "        X_seg, y_seg, test_size=0.2, random_state=42\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Hyperparameter tuning\n",
        "    param_grid = {\n",
        "        'n_estimators': [50, 100],\n",
        "        'max_depth': [3, 5, 10]\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "    grid = GridSearchCV(\n",
        "        RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42),\n",
        "        param_grid,\n",
        "        cv=3\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    grid.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "    best_model = grid.best_estimator_\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "    y_prob = best_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]\n",
        "\n",
        "    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "    pre = precision_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0)\n",
        "    rec = recall_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0)\n",
        "    f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0)\n",
        "    roc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob)\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append({\n",
        "        \"Segment\": seg,\n",
        "        \"Customers\": len(seg_df),\n",
        "        \"Accuracy\": acc,\n",
        "        \"Precision\": pre,\n",
        "        \"Recall\": rec,\n",
        "        \"F1_Score\": f1,\n",
        "        \"ROC_AUC\": roc,\n",
        "        \"Best_Params\": grid.best_params_\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        " results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"\\nMODEL EVALUATION RESULTS:\")\n",
        " print(results_df)\n",
        "\n",
        " results_df.to_csv(\"model_evaluation_results.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 7: FEATURE IMPORTANCE\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # Ensure feature_cols are updated to reflect one-hot encoded columns for importance display\n",
        " # This assumes that feature_cols will eventually be aligned with X's columns after get_dummies\n",
        " # For simplicity, let's just use the columns from X directly for importance visualization.\n",
        " # If you need to map back to original categorical names, a more complex mapping would be needed.\n",
        " importance = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    'Feature': X_seg.columns,\n",
        "    'Importance': best_model.feature_importances_\n",
        " }).sort_values(by='Importance', ascending=False)\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"\\nFeature Importance:\")\n",
        " print(importance)\n",
        "\n",
        " importance.to_csv(\"feature_importance.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # STEP 8: SAVE FINAL SEGMENTED DATA\n",
        " # ======================================================\n",
        " # To save the full df with new segments, ensure X's columns are merged or the original df is processed correctly.\n",
        " # For this step, we assume df already has the segment columns added earlier.\n",
        " df.to_csv(\"segmentation_data.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"\\nFiles Generated:\")\n",
        " print(\"1. segmentation_data.csv\")\n",
        " print(\"2. segment_profiles.csv\")\n",
        " print(\"3. model_evaluation_results.csv\")\n",
        " print(\"4. feature_importance.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        " print(\"\\nWeek 11 Task Completed Successfully!\")"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
